'''Ryan Hase Hase's Hidden Base''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Ryan Hase]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls45.htm Hase's Hidden Base], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228015559/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls45.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
